# dish: a mesh for the world to draw in 3D. A 6.8 m dish on a 5.5 m tripod, aimed up toward -y, its feed and ribs, a cable box; the footprint centre at the origin, its feet on z = 0. Weathered as it stands (sulphur crust on what faces up); kinds 0 painted, 1 metal, 2 glass, 3 lamp. credit: none: our own model (Darwin's Cat), no one else's assets
# dish.mesh: magic CBMESH1, uint32 vertices, uint32 indices; per vertex 40 B: float32 pos xyz (m, z up,
#   the footprint's centre on the ground at 0), float32 normal xyz, float32 uv, uint8 rgb (display sRGB),
#   uint8 kind (0 painted, 1 metal, 2 glass, 3 lamp), uint8 texture (0 none, else a row below), 3 pad;
#   then uint32 indices, 3 per triangle. A textured face: colour and alpha from the texture, cut under 0.5.
front -y
vertices 1848
triangles 936
bytes 85168
